data.long_meaning: The name Rufo is derived from the Latin word ‘rufus’ meaning ‘red’. In ancient Rome, a rufus was a red-headed man. The name was also used for people with a fiery or passionate temperament. The name Rufo carries the meaning “Red” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Rufo usually hope their child will grow to embody red and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rufo total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: רופו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: רופו הוא שם עברי שמקורו בעברית. השם מוכר כמשמע 'בן הבדל' או 'רופא', אך גם יכול להתייחס ל'פעליים' או 'חסם'. במסורת יהודית ונוצרית, השם רופו מקושר ל'חזק' ו'חסם'.

in_greek.name: Ρούφος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ ὄνομα Ρούφος ἐστί σὺν τῇ Ἔλληνι γλῶττῃ. Ὁ ὀρθός τύπος εἶναι Ρούφος. Ἐν τῇ Βίβλῳ οὐχ ἔχει συγκεκριμένη ἀπόκρισιν. Ἡ παλαιότερη μορφή εἶναι Ρούφος, σὺν ἀφίξεις Ρούφου. Ὁ Ρούφος ἐστί σὺν τῇ σημασίᾳ 'ἀνδρός', 'πρῶτος', 'λύπος'.

in_latin.name: Rufo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Rufo est cum Latinorum lingua. Originem habet ab verbi fortis (fortis), rubius (ruber), et ruber (ruber). In Ecclesia Christiana, Rufo est nomen fortis, rubius, et ruber. Etiam significat 'strenuus' et 'coloratus'.
